title: Unstoppable
description: The story charts the journey of two childhood friends Kohinoor Kalyan and Jilani Ramdas. They are both enthusiastic and easy-going. On an unfateful day, the duo loses a heavy amount in cricket betting. They unintentionally enter the villain's traps and they end up destroying their empire. What happens when they face the villains? Is there a reason for them to get involved with the goons?
